_doc: AL-99: the 2D client's main menu, new game, pick and save strings (tools/game_2d/web/menu.js).
ui2d.menu.title: Main menu
ui2d.menu.keys: Esc opens the menu in game
ui2d.menu.bye: The game is closed (autosaved to slot 0). You can close this tab.
ui2d.ng.title: New game
ui2d.ng.seed.hint: A number or any word: the same seed makes the same world.
ui2d.ng.size.small.desc: A narrow valley and a small village: a quick start.
ui2d.ng.size.medium.desc: A usual valley with a river, a forest and a marsh.
ui2d.ng.size.large.desc: Wide lands and a bigger village; a slower world.
ui2d.pick.title: Whom to be
ui2d.pick.kin.hint: Take a person of one of the families: their kin, house and affairs become yours.
ui2d.pick.newcomer.hint: Come to the village a stranger: your past gives skills, traits and belongings.
ui2d.pick.head: head of house
ui2d.saves.autonote: Autosave to slot 0 every {n} min and on quit.
